begins: on a phone, in a group of one they just made, Magnets just brought to it; their housemates are in the house chat

verdict.reason: explored, and said they were done

said.text: Sounds great Sam, I'll be there at 7! Want me to bring anything or help with cleanup?

asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

said.said: Replied to Sam that I'll be at dinner at 7. Then played with the fridge magnets app: "I can explain the entire lasagna situation."

asked.prompt: What do you think this is for?

said.said: A fridge-magnet word game for the house, to make silly sentences. Just for fun, as far as I can tell.
Nothing really. The word tiles kept reordering after each tap and the sentence box was a bit small, but it worked.

asked.prompt: What did you try that didn't do what you expected?

said.said: Nothing failed outright. I expected tapped words to stay put in the list, but they moved up into the sentence and the list shifted. I didn't check whether the sentence can be saved or shared.

asked.prompt: Where did you stop, and why?

said.said: I stopped after one sentence. I'd made what I wanted and had no reason to go on. I didn't scroll through all the words or look for a share option.
